pos: Requests about physical obstructions (bushes, trees, gates, overgrowth) blocking sidewalks or right-of-way, including vegetation and gates.
neg: Anything about line of sight (even if vegetation is mentioned), which is filed under Line of Sight.
Obstruction or blockage of sidewalk or walkway by vegetation that is specifically described as coming from private property or yards, not as a general right-of-way issue.

pos: Reports of high grass, overgrown vegetation, or downed trees on private property or yards, and sometimes trash or debris in yards.
Trash, junk, or debris physically present on private property or yard, especially if described as an accumulation or ongoing problem, not related to pickup, stickers, or container enforcement.

Overgrowth, brush, weeds, or vegetation described as originating from private property or yards, even if it extends onto or over sidewalks or walkways; focus on source/location rather than obstruction effect.
Overgrown yard or vegetation on private property, regardless of mentions of abandonment or animals; focus on yard condition, not building safety.

Vegetation or overgrowth located specifically on private property or a yard, even if it blocks visibility at an intersection or driveway; focus is on the source/location (private property) rather than the effect (visibility).
neg: Overgrowth blocking sidewalks or right-of-way (filed under Blocked Street), or line of sight issues (filed under Line of
Any mention of trash, junk, or debris as a visible accumulation, even if in a yard or with high grass, is filed as Trash, not Excessive Growth.

pos: Any complaint where the main issue is visibility at intersections or driveways due to vegetation, regardless of whether the vegetation is blocking the sidewalk
neg: Physical blockage of sidewalks/right-of-way (filed under Blocked Street), or general excessive growth not affecting visi
Requests mention visibility or line of sight issues, but the overgrowth is described as being on private property or a yard, not in the public right-of-way or city-maintained area.

pos: Vehicles parked on grass, dirt, or lawns, including construction vehicles.
neg: Any other parking or traffic complaints not about surface type.

pos: Offers or issues specifically about park/playground materials or maintenance.
neg: Overgrowth or trash in parks (those are filed under Excessive Growth or Trash).

pos: Issues with sorting, mixing, or improper disposal of recyclables, including when trash is mixed in.
Requests about improper sorting, mixing, or disposal of recyclables, or items not accepted in recycling program, even if labeled as trash or courtesy pickup.
neg: General trash complaints (filed under Trash).

Requests about recycling not being picked up, bins left out, or container size/limit violations—even if the word 'recycling' is used—are filed as Trash unless the complaint is about improper sorting or mixing of recyclables.

pos: Sewer odors, backups, repairs, or related requests about sanitary sewer lines.
Requests referencing sewer repairs, sanitary sewer lines, manholes, or issues with indoor drains (toilets, washers) after sewer work, regardless of mention of water or infrastructure.
neg: Stormwater or drainage issues (filed under Sidewalk Snow Removal).

pos: (No requests filed here.)
neg: Any sidewalk obstruction, snow, or repair issues (those are filed under Blocked Street, Street Snow Removal, or Sidewalk

pos: Requests about stormwater, drainage, culverts, or storm sewer backups, and sometimes requests for grass cutting near storm ditches.
neg: Sidewalk snow/ice removal (filed under Street Snow Removal).

pos: Requests about snow or ice not being cleared from sidewalks, even though the name suggests streets.
neg: Stormwater or drainage issues (filed under Sidewalk Snow Removal).

pos: Any complaint about temporary, sandwich board, banner, or yard card signs without permits.
neg: Permanent sign issues.

pos: General traffic complaints, including parking overlap, storm drain cleaning, and overgrown shrubs blocking vision at intersections (even though this overlaps wi
neg: Most line of sight or vegetation visibility issues (filed under Line of Sight).

pos: Any complaint about trash pickup, stickers, courtesy pickups, or construction debris, including some recycling complaints if the main issue is trash.
Complaints about stickers, weight, or container size/limits for trash bags or cans, even if yard waste is not mentioned
Missed pickup, container issues, or overflow complaints about recycling are filed as Trash if the main action needed is collection or container enforcement, not sorting.
Trash or debris physically present on property, regardless of location (yard, driveway, backyard, alongside house), even if high grass or overgrowth is also mentioned.
neg: Yard waste (filed under Yard Waste), or recycling sorting issues (filed under Recycling).

Complaints about visible trash bags, piles, or debris on property (yard, behind house, driveway, etc.) without mention of trash collection issues; filed as Excessive Growth even if wording focuses on trash.

Requests about missed pickup, stickers, or container size/weight that do not explicitly mention yard waste, Christmas trees, or yard waste bundles are filed as Trash, even if bags or stickers are referenced
When the main issue is about recycling program rules, accepted items, or improper disposal of recyclables, not collection or container enforcement.

pos: Reports of unsafe, abandoned, or collapsing structures, including sheds and vacant buildings.
neg: Overgrown yards or trash (filed under Excessive Growth or Trash).
Mentions of abandoned or unfinished property with overgrown yard, but no explicit report of structural danger or collapse.

pos: Issues with water taste, pressure, leaks, or emergency shut-offs.
Customer requests emergency shut off or reports leak in meter pit; triggers utility action affecting water service, not infrastructure repair.
neg: Water utility billing or main breaks (filed under Water Utility Billing Problems or Water Utility Problems).
Mentions of water quality issues (taste, color, pressure) that prompt a utility action or emergency response, not just a quality test

pos: Any complaint about water bills, account errors, or billing disputes.
neg: Water quality or main break issues (filed under Water Quality or Water Utility Problems).

pos: Water main breaks, line checks, or general water utility infrastructure issues.
Requests involving operational actions on water infrastructure (e.g., emergency shut off, pressure restoration, utility intervention), regardless of mention of taste or appearance
neg: Water quality (filed under Water Quality) or billing (filed under Water Utility Billing Problems).

Mentions of water utility infrastructure or problems that actually involve sewer system components, repairs, or maintenance actions (e.g., manholes, indoor drain issues) rather than water mains or supply lines.
Requests for emergency shut off or meter pit leaks, even if infrastructure terms used, are filed as Water Quality, not Water Utility Problems.

pos: Complaints about yard waste pickup, stickers, or weight limits, including Christmas trees and bundles.

Courtesy pickup, missed pickup, sticker, or container size/weight issue when the underlying service is yard waste collection, even if 'trash' or 'garbage' is mentioned; also, any reference to yard waste mixed with trash, or yard waste-specific rules (e.g., can't take wire with yard waste)
neg: General trash (filed under Trash) or recycling (filed under Recycling).
If the request does not explicitly mention yard waste, Christmas trees, or yard waste bundles, it is filed as Trash, even if bags or stickers are referenced
